limits: The launcher is single use and refuses an existing unit/status directory. If recovery is needed, this launcher must not be reused as a generic restart; invoke the same sealed controller through a separately reviewed fixed recovery launch.
Observer is a sequential read of PID1, result and checkpoint, not an atomic system snapshot; pending/changed observations do not establish success.
No live resolved reload, DNS response or runtime job delta is proved by source review.
scope: local independent source review only; no systemd-run, activation or VPS access

switch_transient_unit_handling.finding: collect_unit_changes skips FragmentPath outside the NixOS managed /etc/systemd/system directory; detached /run/systemd/transient service is not stopped as a removed NixOS unit.
